# Williams Fractals

*Marks highs and lows that stand above or below their neighbours.*

**Kind** indicator · **Drawn** on the price pane

## Try it

On the chart, press <kbd>/</kbd> and choose **Williams Fractals** under **Support & resistance**. To change it, copy the source below into the AlphaScript editor.

## Inputs

| Input | Type | Default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Periods | int | `2` |
| Up fractal color | color | `"#089981"` |
| Down fractal color | color | `"#F23645"` |

## Source

From `packages/alphascript/indicators/fractals.as.js`.

```js
indicator({ name: "Williams Fractals", shortTitle: "Fractals", overlay: true });
const n = input.int("Periods", 2, { min: 2, max: 50 });
const up = ta.calc([ta.pivothigh(n, n)], (v) => (v === v ? 1 : 0)), down = ta.calc([ta.pivotlow(n, n)], (v) => (v === v ? 1 : 0));
plotShape(up, { shape: "triangleDown", location: "aboveBar", offset: -n, color: input.color("Up fractal color", "#089981", { group: "Style" }) });
plotShape(down, { shape: "triangleUp", location: "belowBar", offset: -n, color: input.color("Down fractal color", "#F23645", { group: "Style" }) });
```
